name: root-cause
description: Debug-loop breaker for agents: evidence-based bug diagnosis instead of blind fix attempts. Restates the symptom in one falsifiable sentence, forces a minimal runnable repro before any code change, bisects the introducing change with git, states the root cause as a [HYPOTHESIS] claim, runs the confirm or refute experiment, and only then fixes. Hard rule: max 3 fix attempts per bug, then stop and report. Every experiment is logged to debug-report.md. Ships a stdlib git-bisect runner (bisect_helper.py) that reports the first bad commit in machine-readable form.
